link_notes: Linked repo (ryan112358/mbi) is the general MBI estimation library, not MST or AIM themselves; paper full text unavailable.

open_release.rationale: AIM produces differentially private synthetic data, which is a formal privacy guarantee.

quotes.text: We propose AIM, a new algorithm for differentially private synthetic data generation. AIM is a workload-adaptive algorithm

pipeline_testing.rationale: No testing or format framing in the abstract or README.

ml_augmentation.rationale: Full text is missing, so ML utility evaluation cannot be checked.

statistical_replication.rationale: AIM is judged on query-error accuracy of the generated data against the input data.

quotes.text: We also provide analytic expressions to bound per-query error with high probability which can be used to construct confidence intervals and inform users about the accuracy of generated data.

education.rationale: README is a library quick start, not teaching material.

benchmarking.rationale: AIM is compared against other mechanisms; full text is missing to see use as a baseline by others.

quotes.text: We show empirically that AIM consistently outperforms a wide variety of existing mechanisms across a variety of experimental settings.
